planning_notes: Board is fixed to arduino:avr:uno. Wired pins used exactly as provided: D2/D3/D4 (three bed call buttons), D7 (nurse confirm), D13 (LED), D6 (buzzer tone), TM1637 CLK=D8 and DIO=D5.
No explicit button polarity/pullup wiring was supplied; set active_high=true so the model Boolean becomes true when the button is pressed (initial=false).

TM1637 is modeled as tm1637_number with initial 0 and leading_zero=false; the requirement says it shows 'bed number and seconds'. Since tm1637_number only supports a single numeric value, the SysML model must define an encoding (e.g., combined value or alternation) and update strategy.

Serial protocol for '处理日志' was not specified beyond baud=9600 and fixed framing settings. Therefore, serial reporting is assumed to be typed numeric fields under one trigger gate when SysML logs an event. If a fixed exact-text line protocol is required, the model must use serial_text_output(s) with exact required text instead.

Control period chosen as 5 ms for responsiveness to button presses and accurate elapsed_ms accumulation; any additional reporting or buzzer patterns must be handled in SysML using elapsed_ms rather than in device requests.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Bed 1 call button (press triggers call record and alarm until cleared by confirm)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Bed 2 call button (press triggers call record and alarm until cleared by confirm)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Bed 3 call button (press triggers call record and alarm until cleared by confirm)

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Nurse confirm button (clears highest-priority pending call and logs handling)

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: Alarm LED indicator (on while there is an active call requiring alarm)

interfaces.name: io_5
interfaces.meaning: Audible alarm buzzer frequency (tone enabled while there is an active call requiring alarm)

interfaces.name: io_6
interfaces.meaning: Wait display: bed number and waiting seconds (model determines the displayed number+seconds encoding/updates)

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Report serial log gate when a call is placed or cleared/confirmed (SysML decides the exact moment to assert)

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_0
interfaces.meaning: Most-recent event elapsed time since previous step when the event occurs (for debugging/log timestamping delta)

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_1
interfaces.meaning: Bed index involved in the most-recent logged event (1..3 model-mapped)

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_2
interfaces.meaning: Waiting time in seconds associated with the logged event (model conversion from control time)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 设计一个病房呼叫与响应记录系统，使用床位按钮 D2、D3、D4 分别对应三张床，护士确认按钮 D7、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、蜂鸣器 D6、LED D13 和串口。任一床位按下后系统记录呼叫顺序和等待时间并报警提示；确认按钮按下后清除当前最高优先级呼叫并输出处理日志。数码管显示当前等待最久的床位编号和秒数。
